language.name: English
media.cannotSwap: Cannot swap. Both files must be images.
action.stopTip: Stop or close the current view
action.pickMediaTip: Pick a source face and a target first
camera.selectSourceFirst: Please select a source image first
camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission is not enabled. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera, allow DeepFaceCam, then click Live again.
camera.permissionUnavailable: No available camera was found. Connect a camera, then rescan.
camera.permissionBusy: The camera is currently being used by another app. Close that app, then try again.
camera.permissionFailed: The camera did not open. Check camera permission and camera status, then try again.
camera.openFailedHelp: The camera did not open. Make sure it is not used by another app and allow DeepFaceCam in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera.
stage.liveStartingHint: First start can take a few seconds. The preview will appear when the camera and models are ready.
stage.previewFailed: Preview failed. Check the media, models, or backend log.
stage.liveHint: Adjust options on the left while the preview is running.
options.title: Advanced options
options.many_faces.label: Swap all faces
options.many_faces.tip: Process every detected face instead of only the primary face.
options.map_faces.label: Map faces manually
options.map_faces.tip: Choose which source face maps to each target face.
options.map_faces.status: Manual mapping opens before generation and turns off Swap all faces.
options.live_mirror.label: Mirror live preview
options.show_fps.label: Show FPS
options.show_fps.tip: Display the live preview frame rate.
options.keep_fps.label: Keep video FPS
options.keep_fps.tip: Match the output video frame rate to the original.
options.keep_audio.label: Keep original audio
options.keep_audio.tip: Copy the original video's audio track into the output.
options.keep_frames.label: Keep temporary frames
options.keep_frames.tip: Leave extracted video frames on disk after processing.
options.poisson_blend.label: Smooth face edge
options.poisson_blend.tip: Blend face edges with Poisson blending.
options.color_correction.label: Fix blue/green cast
options.color_correction.tip: Correct color casts from some webcams or videos.
options.nsfw_filter.label: NSFW filter
options.nsfw_filter.tip: Skip processing if NSFW content is detected.
options.faceEnhancer.liveDisabled: The current runtime is not suitable for live face repair. CUDA or DirectML can enable it. Image and video generation can still use it.
options.faceEnhancer.liveEnabled: CUDA or DirectML runtime detected. Live preview can use face repair, but it may lower FPS.
enhancer.none.label: Off
enhancer.none.tip: Fastest. Keeps the raw swap result without extra face repair.
enhancer.fast.label: Fast repair
enhancer.fast.tip: Uses GPEN-256. Lightweight repair for live preview or low-end devices.
enhancer.hd.label: HD repair
enhancer.hd.tip: Uses GPEN-512. Better facial detail for videos and images, with a larger FPS cost.
enhancer.strong.label: Strong repair
enhancer.strong.tip: Uses GFPGAN. Strongest repair for blurry or low-res faces, but can look smoother or less natural.
refinement.title: Fine tuning
refinement.blend.label: Blend strength
refinement.blend.tip: How much of the generated face is applied. 0% keeps the original; 100% fully swaps.
refinement.sharpness.label: Sharpness
refinement.mouthMask.label: Mouth protection
refinement.mouthMask.tip: 0 keeps the swapped mouth; higher values preserve more of the original mouth and chin.
settings.title: Settings
settings.diagnosticsHint: Check CUDA, actual model providers, and live timing.
settings.diagnosticsNoGpu: No NVIDIA GPU or nvidia-smi detected.
settings.diagnosticsNoLiveMetrics: Start live preview to see per-stage timings.
mapping.description.live: Pair source faces with target faces, then submit to start live preview.
mapping.description.video: Confirm or assign source faces for each detected target face.
mapping.empty.live: No mappings yet. Add one to begin.
mapping.validRequired: At least 1 source with target is required.
model.title: Models Required
model.description: First run needs models before face swap can work. Models are saved in your user data folder, not inside the installed app.
